newsitem.title: USA: Nantucket sues Levi Strauss over license.
newsitem.headline: Nantucket sues Levi Strauss over license.

text.p: Nantucket Industries Inc said Monday it has filed a $37 million lawsuit against Levi Strauss & Co in state court in San Francisco, arising out of Levi's Jan 22 announcement that it was putting its Brittania Sportswear Ltd subsidiary up for sale.

Nantucket has made men's undergarments under the licensed trademark "Brittania from Levi Strauss & Co.," and has been a licensee of Brittania's since 1988. The parties entered into a new license agreement on January 1, said the company, only three weeks before Levi's announcement.
